routes.label: Find what makes the universal statement false

question: The negation of the statement “all men are honest,” is:
solution: The statement “all men are honest” fails if at least one man is not honest. Its negation is therefore “some men are dishonest,” where “some” means at least one. It does not require every man to be dishonest. The answer is choice C.
